items.title: Meta ordered to pay $25 billion in New Mexico case over Cambridge Analytica scandal
items.brief: A New Mexico judge ordered Meta to pay $25 billion after the company was found to have misled users about its privacy practices in a case related to the Cambridge Analytica scandal .

items.title: Subtropical Storm Josephine forms off Mid-Atlantic coast
items.brief: Subtropical Storm Josephine just formed off the coast of the Mid-Atlantic, but will largely be nothing more than a nuisance for coastal areas as it moves north.

items.title: New Mexico attorney general files civil lawsuit against two Epstein advisers
items.brief: New Mexico Attorney General Raúl Torrez on Wednesday filed a civil lawsuit against two of Jeffrey Epstein’s closest advisers, accusing them of having “facilitated and concealed” Epstein’s crimes.
